A '''pipe''' was a means of [[Smoking/Legends|smoking]]. [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] sometimes smoked wooden pipes, and [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]] smoked from a [[Hookah pipe/Legends|hookah pipe]].<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref> [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gorgi]] was known to smoke a pipe while off duty.<ref name="Godking">{{WEGCite|book=Classic Campaigns|story=Tests of the Godking}}</ref> The [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Katykam]] smoked a [[Clay/Legends|clay]] pipe.<ref name="A">''[[The Abduction]]''</ref>
